title: Kya Mai Yateem
body:
kyun mujhpe sitam dhaane laga shimr e sitamgar
kya mai yateem hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal mein sakina ye buka karti thi ro kar
kya mai yateem hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
khaata hi nahi rehm ghareebon pe zara bhi
durre wo lagata hai kabhi deta ghudki
reh reh ke mujhe hota hai ehsaas yahan par
kya mai yateem hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
dam ghut'ta hai is zulm ke mahol se mera
yaad aati hai baba ki to phat'ta hai kaleja
sone ke liye mujhko mila khaak ka bistar
kya mai yateem hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad bhi seene se lagate hai ye keh kar
ab laut ke aayenge nahi baba kabhi ghar
is baat pe chalte hai mere qalb pe khanjar
kya mai yateem hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
bas itna bata dijiye mujhko phuphi amma
kab tak mujhe is dasht mein rehna hai hirasan
baba ko sada deti hoo aate nahi kyun kar
kya mai yateem hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
bikhre huwe laashe hai bayaban mein har soo
is dasht mein kyun chod gaye hai mujhe ammu
kyun nahi leta koi khabar bhi meri aa kar
kya mai yateem hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
amma mujhe aaghosh mein tum apni chupa lo
kuch dayr to pehlu mein zara mujhko sula lo
mai jaagti rehti hoon to rehta hai yehi darr
kya mai yateem hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay baba kahan ho mai tumhe dhoond rahi hoon
har laash ko baba ki samajh kar mai giri hoon
patthar se kabhi laashon se khaati hoon thokar
kya mai yateem hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
bin baap ki bacchi ki fughan safdar o mazhar
ek marsiya lagne lagi qirtaas pe aa kar
jab khaak udaate huwe kehti thi wo muztar
kya mai yateem hoon...
author: Mazhar Abidi
